fast_decision.description: Interactive decision regeneration. A fresh Official snapshot may be reused for at most 60 seconds inside the same working directory so a bounded warm retry does not refetch or perturb its own canonical evidence. The canonical official_snapshot.json remains ephemeral. A workspace-local retry mirror can restore it only inside the same job and is excluded from runtime-data hydration and publication, so every new production job still performs a fresh Official pull. Official detail keeps its one-hour reuse window plus a bounded 60-second scheduler/retry jitter grace so an artifact that qualified at the start of a FAST attempt cannot cross the freshness boundary a few seconds later during the single permitted warm retry. Core Official current-state evidence remains freshly acquired every production job. REC-41 tactical-role/system fields are already published in runtime-data, so advanced player features may use the normal six-hour freshness window only while their cached player identity exactly matches the current Official player universe. Historical priors are still re-indexed every run so current Official club identity is reconciled against cached previous-season evidence. Prediction and tactical_context are declared with zero age so age-based reuse is impossible; only exact content-addressed fingerprint reuse can qualify for those capabilities.

live.description: Match/live decision path. Advanced player features may use the normal six-hour freshness window only while their cached player identity exactly matches the current Official player universe; historical priors remain transfer-aware on every run. Prediction is declared with zero age so only exact content-addressed fingerprint reuse can qualify; stale age-based prediction reuse remains impossible.
